author: Mark Atwood
text: Self-flagging as opinion per /review-rusty calibration rule. The 8 sequential ifs ARE the workspace AGENTS.md 'boring readable code' answer; the suggested helper-fn refactor adds abstraction for aesthetics, not engineering pressure. No correctness, performance, or security concern. The 9th-10th-field maintenance compound is real but small; the refactor cost equals 1-2 additional fields' worth of explicit checks. /do-beads pass should close as wontfix unless the workspace deliberately wants to standardise on a helper pattern across all *-server crates (which would be its own propagation epic, not this one).
